_comment:
Source definitions. JSON, not YAML — ruled 2026-08-07 (Q22). Keyed by source name, so a duplicate name is unwritable rather than merely discouraged. Underscore-prefixed keys are comments; every other unknown key is a hard validation error. Use the /add-source skill to onboard a new one.

HARD RULE 1 — EVERY source below is `enabled: false` and every url is the REMPLACER placeholder, because no endpoint in this file has been verified against the live site. CLAUDE.md hard rule 1 forbids writing an endpoint from memory, and the loader REFUSES an enabled source whose url still contains REMPLACER — so this file cannot be half-enabled by accident. Unblocking a source needs a DevTools cURL capture from the developer; docs/SOURCES.md records which sites answer a plain client and which 403 it.
_why: The single flag that disarms the fail-closed rule of CLAUDE.md §1. It is REQUIRED on every block — the loader refuses a source that omits it, and SourceProfile independently defaults it to true. `false` is a claim that this landlord publishes NO social stock whatsoever, and it is only defensible for In'li (Action Logement's intermediate arm) and the private-market portals. Every value here is bound to tests/fixtures/tenure/corpus.json by ConfigTest, so the two cannot drift apart silently.

inli._comment: A1, docs/SOURCES.md. The flagship: ~60 000 LLI units across IDF, covers both 78 and 95, rents 20-30% below market. Pure LLI, which is why mixed_tenure is false here and almost nowhere else. THE FIRST VERIFIED SOURCE IN THIS FILE (2026-08-19).
inli._source: Fetched from the live site, robots.txt read FIRST: `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /espace-membre/` only, so /locations/ is allowed and this poll is within hard rule 5. The search page is SERVER-RENDERED — there is no JSON API behind it (the route map at /locations/js/routes and the app bundle expose only member-area endpoints), which is why type is `html` and not `json`. Frozen payload: tests/fixtures/inli/search.html, scrubbed of the page's embedded third-party Google API key.
inli._why: WHY THE FILTERS ARE LOOSER THAN criteria.json (ruled 2026-08-19): In'li applies price_max/area_min/room_min server-side, so anything it rejects never reaches CriteriaEngine — no score, no log, no `à vérifier` entry. That is the silent over-rejection hard rule 8 warns about, and it is invisible precisely because nothing arrives. So the URL casts a WIDE net and criteria.json does the real filtering, where every rejection is scored and logged; tightening your criteria later then needs no re-capture. WHY PAGINATION: measured, not assumed — these filters returned `92 logements` across 4 pages of 24 [2026-08-19]. A page-one-only read would have dropped 68 listings on every pass and reported a healthy run. total_selector is what makes the walk checkable: collecting fewer than the page declares is a hard failure, because a page=N that quietly 404s ends the walk exactly like a real last page.

map._comment: Selectors, not dotted paths — see src/php/Adapters/Html/Selector.php. `=>` introduces a capture, because the card packs rooms and surface into ONE text node (`3 pièces · 55.32 m²`) and a general number parser would return whichever comes first.
map._charges_included: The card prints `cc` in a sibling span beside the figure — charges comprises, confirmed on all 19 cards of the frozen capture.

icf_novedis._comment: A2. ICF Habitat's non-social arm — 10 000 units aimed at households above the social ceilings. SNCF group, so stock clusters on rail corridors, which fits the boucle de Seine. mixed_tenure stays TRUE (Q20, ruled 2026-08-07): `false` would be right for a Novedis-only endpoint and wrong for the group portal, and nothing here yet says which the adapter will hit. Costs a few digest entries; cannot cost an application.

cdc_habitat._comment: A3, docs/SOURCES.md. THE SECOND VERIFIED SOURCE, and the FIRST MIXED-TENURE one (2026-08-20) -- CDC Habitat publishes social and intermediate and free-market stock in one result set, which is what mixed_tenure and the whole classifier exist for. In'li was pure LLI, so until now nothing exercised the fail-closed path against a real payload.
cdc_habitat._source: robots.txt read FIRST, and it is the reason this block looks the way it does. CDC disallows /Recherche/show/, /Recherche/search AND seven search QUERY PARAMETERS by name (?cdTypeBien, ?nbSurfaceMin, ?nbSurfaceMax, ?cdCategorieLogement, ?nbPiece, ?nbLoyerMin, ?nbLoyerMax). So the parameterised search is off limits entirely. What IS advertised -- by the site's own sitemap.xml, linked from that same robots.txt -- is the lowercase, query-free /recherche/location/<region> tree, and robots path matching is case-sensitive, so /Recherche/... does not cover it. Frozen payload: tests/fixtures/cdc_habitat/search.html, checked for secrets before committing (no keys, no tokens, no session ids; the only email is the string `adresse@mail.com` in an accessibility hint and the `page_chapter2` codes are the landlord's own analytics chapters, not phone numbers).
cdc_habitat._why: WHY THE REGION URL AND NOT 78+95: same ruling as In'li -- server-side filtering silently over-rejects, because anything the site drops never reaches CriteriaEngine and so is never scored, never logged and never lands in the `a verifier` digest (hard rule 8). The region page declares `134 logements disponibles` at 16 per page [measured 2026-08-20]; criteria.json does the real filtering, where every rejection is visible. WHY page_path AND NOT page_param: pagination here is a PATH segment (/page-2/), and appending ?page=2 instead would put a query string on a URL whose query space robots disallows. WHY total_selector: the walk must be checkable -- the page states its own count, and collecting fewer than it declares is a hard failure rather than a thin market.
cdc_habitat._page_path: NO TRAILING SLASH, and that is measured. The site's OWN pagination links are written `/page-2/` and the site 301s them to `/page-2` [2026-08-20]. The adapter refuses a non-2xx rather than following it, deliberately: a redirect that lands back on page one terminates a walk exactly like a real last page. So the canonical form is requested directly and no redirect is involved.

map._comment: CSS selectors with an optional @attr and an optional `=> regex` capture -- see src/php/Adapters/Html/Selector.php. The card packs rooms, floor and surface into ONE heading (`3 pieces - 4eme etage - 82m2`), so each needs its own capture: a general number read would return the room count for all three.
map.title: .description h3
map._floor: Captured as PROSE, not as a number, and read by Payload::floor(): `RDC` is the ground floor and the ground floor is 0, not unknown (hard rule 9). Five of the thirteen distinct floor strings on the Yvelines page are RDC.
map._elevator: Captured from the amenity list as the NOUN, which is how the card asserts it. Absence of the word is NOT a denial: the capture simply fails and the field stays null, so this can never manufacture the explicit false the high-floor penalty needs (hard rule 9).
map._tenure_field: The card's own tenure badge: `Logement a loyer libre`, `Logement intermediaire`, and -- on other departments -- the social variants. This is signal priority 2 (an explicit label), the highest this source offers on a search card. A badge the classifier does not recognise lowers confidence rather than defaulting, and with mixed_tenure true that routes to `a verifier` instead of a match.
map._charges_included: VERIFIED, not assumed: the detail page for the card printing `1 668,67 EUR` states `Loyer charges comprises | 1 668,67 EUR / mois`, and itemises what the charges cover [measured 2026-08-20].

cityloger._comment: A6b, docs/SOURCES.md. Cityloger IS the Immobiliere 3F group's lettings platform, and it is how 3F stock is reachable at all: groupe3f.fr publishes no vacancies (its own 'je cherche un logement' route links out to al-in.fr), and this site is where the group actually lists. Low volume, high precision: 51 rentals nationally on 2026-08-20, of which 3 in IDF -- because the SOCIAL stock is allocated through AL'in and the SNE, so what surfaces here skews to the intermediate and libre stock this project is looking for. mixed_tenure is true regardless: the national feed does carry social listings (an Occitanie one is frozen as a fixture).
cityloger._source: robots.txt read FIRST and frozen at tests/fixtures/cityloger/robots.txt: it disallows only /composants/ /classes/ /include/ /dpe/ /newdpe/, nothing near the search. Results are server-rendered by an infinite-scroll partial (jquery.jscroll) that answers a plain GET with no cookie and no token -- pages 2 and 3 return disjoint sets, and page 7 of a 51-listing feed returns 29 bytes and zero cards, so the walk terminates on its own. Frozen payloads: results.html (page 1 as served), detail-intermediate.html (Antony, Financement LI15P) and detail-social.html (Occitanie, Financement PEXNC), all scrubbed of contact addresses.
cityloger._why:
URL TEMPLATE: the page number sits MID-PATH, so page_path cannot express it -- page_path appends. The rejected alternative was url = the site root, letting page 1 be the homepage widget, whose ten cards are identical to page 1's today [verified 2026-08-20]; that equality is not a guarantee, and if the widget ever becomes 'featured' rather than ranks 1-10, page one is never fetched and nothing says so.
DETAIL MAP: the search card carries NO tenure -- not a badge, not a code, nothing -- so on a mixed source every listing would resolve UNKNOWN and land in the a-verifier digest forever, which is correct under CLAUDE.md section 1 and useless. The tenure lives on the detail page, so gated listings get a second request; the gate is the run's own commune filter, supplied by the CLI, so 51 national listings cost at most 3 detail fetches rather than 51. SELECTORS MUST ADDRESS THE LISTING'S OWN CONTENT: measured 2026-08-20, the scoped .description classifies the Antony flat LLI at 0.90 while the SAME listing fed its whole detail page classifies UNKNOWN at 0.00 -- the page's furniture ('Commission d'attribution', 'demande de logement social') sits on social and intermediate pages alike and conflicts the verdict away.
TENURE FIELD REGEX: the financement value sits in the third of three <table class="table"> with nothing to tell them apart, and the first span.label.label-success happens to be it on both frozen pages -- by POSITION, so a new label above it would silently feed a DATE into the tenure field. Anchoring on the word Financement cannot return a date.
FLOOR: two entries, first non-null wins. Cards say `3e etg`, which Payload::floor's own `etage` pattern does not match, so the capture hands it a bare number instead; the `rdc` fallback is the ground floor, which is 0 and not unknown (hard rule 9), and Payload::floor already reads that word.

seqens._comment: A5. Action Logement group, strong 78/95 footprint. robots.txt clean (/wp-admin/ only). Publishes social AND intermediate stock on the same pages — see CLAUDE.md, 'The Action Logement wrinkle'.

seloger._comment: B1. Largest IDF inventory. Private market, so LIBRE — in scope since the Q4 answer. type is email_alert because direct scraping of a private portal is opt-in, disabled by default and refuses to run without an explicit flag (hard rule 4); the email-alert route is within ToS, defeats anti-bot because there is no bot, and fires on publication rather than on a poll.

leboncoin._comment: B2. Where non-agency private landlords actually post. 403s a plain client, so email alert is the only route regardless of preference.

fixture_demo._comment: NOT a real landlord. A frozen-payload source that exercises the whole pipeline end to end offline — config load, fetch, field map, classify, criteria, dedup, store, notify — with no network and no credentials. It is what makes `scout run --once` verifiable before any real endpoint is captured, and it is enabled BECAUSE it reads a committed file rather than the internet. mixed_tenure is true so the fixture exercises the fail-closed path, which is the half that matters.

email_demo._comment: NOT a real portal. A frozen ALERT-EMAIL source, the mailbox twin of fixture_demo: it exercises the whole email-alert path — IMAP-shaped mailbox, MIME parse, charset conversion, link extraction, classify, criteria, notify — with no credentials and no network. Enabled because it reads committed .eml files. Point MAILBOX_DIR at tests/fixtures/mailbox to run it; set IMAP_HOST instead and the same source reads a real mailbox with no other change.
